Have you seen those cute cube watermelon「Shikaku Suika」in Japan?
Now you get to grow them on your farm!
This mod adds a square watermelon as a crop that you can plant and use it as a ornamental, use it for artisan goods, or just sell them for a good profit!
You can purchase the seeds at Pierre's shop starting in year 1.

─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Compatible with 1.6
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
This is my second mod, please let me know if you encounter errors or bugs!
I am always open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else!
I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission!
